description.text: One of the eleventh pair of Scarlet & Violet expansions, released on 6 June 2025 together with Black Bolt. Between them the two packs hold all 156 Pokémon first found in the Unova region, and every Pokémon in them has an Art Rare or Special Art Rare card. Reshiram ex leads White Flare, with Keldeo ex, Hydreigon ex, Whimsicott ex, Jellicent ex and Bouffalant ex and the Supporters Hilda and Harlequin. Each pack held seven cards, and the set was also sold as Expansion Pack Deluxe, packs of 35 cards with one Art Rare certain in each. The cards are numbered to 86, followed by Art Rare cards of its Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Supporters, Special Art Rare cards, and Reshiram ex as a Black White Rare, a rarity made for the pair, drawn in white. In English most of its cards came out in White Flare in July 2025.
